Bach to Tchaikovsky

21

September

About

Romantic, powerful, and deeply moving—this concert features breathtaking melodies, an unforgettable finale, and dazzling solos from Concertmaster Javier Chaparro and Assistant Principal Cellist Elizabeth Lee.

Time & Location

Complementary Pre-Concert Reception: 3:30 PM
Concert Starts: 5:00 PM
Rudder Theatre

Featuring

Javier Chaparro, violin
Elizabeth Lee, cello

Program:

Bach: Chaconne from Partita No. 2
Brahms: Double Concerto for Violin and Cello
Tchaikovsky: Symphony No. 4
